create_CLISubcommand: create a CLISubcommand subclass to define a new vLLM CLI subcommand with cmd and subparser_init methods
build_subparser_init: build a subparser_init method that registers argparse subparser arguments for a CLI subcommand
test_validate: test the validate method of a CLISubcommand subclass to ensure argparse.Namespace args pass validation
run_cmd: run the cmd method of a CLISubcommand subclass with parsed argparse.Namespace arguments
review_CLISubcommand: review the CLISubcommand base class and its cmd, validate, and subparser_init methods
